items.title: The naive cotangent complex of algebraic spaces localizes etale on source and target
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: In a commutative diagram of algebraic spaces over a scheme with etale vertical maps p : U -> X and q : V -> Y, the lemma identifies the restriction of the naive cotangent complex NL_{X/Y} to the etale site of U with NL_{U/V} in D(O_U). The retained proof computes: formation of NL commutes with pullback (Modules on Sites), the small etale pullback of O_X is O_U, and g^{-1}O_{V_etale} = p^{-1}f^{-1}O_{Y_etale} because q^{-1}O_{Y_etale} = O_{V_etale} by the etale exactness lemma in Properties of Spaces; tracing the definitions gives the identification. Retained author proof at lines 5310-5321.
